description: This file defines API routes for managing lessons in an LMS backend, including listing, retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting lessons with role-based access control.

methods.name: LessonOut _row_to_lesson_out(row: dict)
methods.description: Converts a database row dictionary to a LessonOut object.

methods.name: LessonsList list_lessons( user=Depends(get_current_user), limit: int = Query(default=50, ge=1, le=200, description="Max items to return"), offset: int = Query(default=0, ge=0, description="Offset for pagination"), search: str | None = Query(default=None, description="Filter by title contains"), published: bool | None = Query(default=None, description="Filter by published status (Admin/HR only)"), )
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list lessons with optional search and role-based filtering.

methods.name: LessonOut get_lesson(lesson_id: str, user=Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Handles GET requests to fetch a specific lesson by ID with role-based access control.

methods.name: LessonOut create_lesson(payload: LessonCreate, user=Depends(require_roles("admin", "hr")))
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new lesson, restricted to admin and HR roles.

methods.name: LessonOut update_lesson(lesson_id: str, payload: LessonUpdate, _: dict = Depends(require_roles("admin", "hr")))
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing lesson, restricted to admin and HR roles.

methods.name: None delete_lesson(lesson_id: str, _: dict = Depends(require_roles("admin", "hr")))
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a lesson, restricted to admin and HR roles.
